from.place: Restriction compatibility for the prescribed local trace

title: Restriction compatibility of the inverse degree-zero Hom correspondence
statement: For a commutative ring A, etale maps p:T→U, v:U→S, w:T→S with w=p≫v, sheaves M,Q on S_et and a specified isomorphism alpha:K≅single(M), let psi:v-restriction M→v-restriction Q. The inverse Hom correspondence of [lem-amb-etale-degree-zero-hom] sends compRestriction v p w psi to the conjugation by the derived compositor of p-pullback of the inverse Hom image of psi. The final compositor is evaluated at single(Q). There is no trace, frame, counit or noetherian hypothesis. The composition of comparison isomorphisms is [lem-amb-etale-single-restriction-comp].

source.place: Overlap calculation: inverse image and the degree-zero Hom correspondence commute with restriction

proof.text: The inverse fully faithful Hom equivalence is the map of alpha followed by the restriction comparison, the singleFunctor image of psi, and the inverse target comparison. Apply etaleSingleRestrictionIso_comp to move the composite restriction comparison past the derived compositor. The inverse comparison equation follows by taking inverses of the corresponding equality of object isomorphisms. Naturality of the derived compositor with alpha and of the single restriction comparison with psi then cancels the intermediate comparisons. Functoriality identifies the three remaining sheaf factors with compRestriction. All steps are actual categorical equalities, with no unproved inputs.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleDegreeZeroHomEquiv_symm_compRestriction (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {T U S : Scheme.{u}} (p : T ⟶ U) (v : U ⟶ S) (w : T ⟶ S)
    [Etale p] [Etale v] [Etale w] (hw : w = p ≫ v)
    {K : DerivedCategoryModule A S}
    {M Q : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)}
    (α : K ≅ (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)
    (ψ : (localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).obj M ⟶
      (localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).obj Q) :
    (etaleDegreeZeroHomEquiv A w α).symm (compRestriction v p w hw ψ) =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p v w hw).hom.app K ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A p).map ((etaleDegreeZeroHomEquiv A v α).symm ψ) ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p v w hw).inv.app
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj Q)
